# Paypoint Solutions

> Zero-fee payment processing, free POS equipment, and card terminals for Texas businesses, with local in-person support based in Seguin, TX.

Paypoint Solutions LLC is a local merchant services provider helping Texas businesses accept credit cards without processing fees. Free terminal placement requires minimum $20,000/month processing volume. Cash Discount Program fees are disclosed at point of sale in compliance with Visa and Mastercard network rules.

## Services

- Zero-Fee Processing: accept cards with no processing fees through a compliant cash discount program.
- Free Terminal: brand-new POS terminal or card reader at no upfront cost for qualifying businesses.
- Fee Audit: review of current merchant statements to identify savings.
- Local Support: direct, in-person help across Seguin, New Braunfels, San Marcos, Schertz, Cibolo, San Antonio, Austin, and surrounding Texas cities.
